title: Building the bazooka with Noon; playing for Pat O'Brien and Walter Coquille
summary: Nelson, Noon (Edward Johnson) and others played two guitars and a bazooka made from hose; they played for Pat O'Brien, went to Florida, and worked with Walter Coquille on radio.
